_what: THE INTAKE GATE. One entry per panel or table that supplies a VALUE. Filled BEFORE any digitiser was written.
_why: The two curations that took their values from a publisher Source Data file (NG_2025) and from the authors' own repository (WT_2026) have ZERO digitisation defects between them. The four that digitised have eight value-changing findings: F-006, F-008, F-017, F-018, F-019, F-020, F-033, F-040.

_tiers.1_publisher_source_data: a Source Data file published with the paper
_tiers.2_si_tables: an xlsx/csv/docx table in the supplementary information
_tiers.3_author_repository: the authors' own repo, Zenodo, Dryad, figshare
_tiers.4_pdf_text_table: a real text table inside the PDF (pdfplumber)
_tiers.4b_pdf_vector_geometry: the PDF's own vector path coordinates, no raster
_tiers.5_pixels: digitised from a figure. THE LAST RESORT.

_rule: A panel recorded as 5_pixels MUST fill why_tiers_1_to_4_failed with a sentence a reviewer can check. 'Not available' is not such a sentence.

_tier_exhaustion_evidence.tier_1_publisher_source_data: NONE EXISTS. Wiley/Angew Chem publishes one supplementary file for this article, anie74215-sup-0001-suppmat.docx (14,164,113 bytes, sha256 e489457984f7efc2fe6317bbc05eb7a7691694a371d67f7eed2f34954d929997). It is the Supporting Information document, not a Source Data workbook. No .xlsx, .csv or .zip asset is referenced anywhere in the article or the SI.
_tier_exhaustion_evidence.tier_2_si_tables: NONE EXISTS, and this was checked two ways because a sibling curation in this run found its SI's tables were EMF images that a <w:tbl> tag count could not see. (a) <w:tbl> element count in word/document.xml = 0. (b) The string 'Table S' occurs ZERO times in 959,060 characters of word/document.xml -- the SI has no numbered tables at all, so there is no table for a tag count to have missed. (c) All 83 files in word/media were enumerated and typed: 48 PNG + 28 SVG (Schemes S1-S12 and Figures S1-S29, i.e. synthesis schemes and NMR/ESI-MS spectra), 4 TIFF (Figures S30-S33: molar-fraction optimisation, particle size, PDI, zeta potential), 2 EMF (Figures S34-S35: cell viability, endosomal escape), 1 PNG pair (Figure S37, serum biochemistry). The two EMF metafiles DO carry a text layer and were checked; they are bar charts of viability and endosomal escape, neither of which is a delivery endpoint, and neither is a table.
_tier_exhaustion_evidence.tier_3_author_repository: NONE EXISTS. Data Availability Statement, verbatim: 'The data that support the findings of this study are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.' provenance/tools/find_repo.py returned repo_hits: [] for BOTH the first author (--author Jiang) and the corresponding/PI author (--author Liu). An accession sweep for GSE/SRP/PRJNA/SRX/SRR/SRA/accession/deposit/github/zenodo/dryad/figshare/osf.io/Source Data/PXD/IPX over 3,126,538 characters (40,301 main-PDF text + 959,060 SI word/document.xml + 2,127,177 SI SVG text layers) returned 5 apparent hits, ALL of which were verified by printing their surrounding context to be base64-encoded embedded-font bytes inside the SVGs ('GSE1', 'SRP3', 'SRP7', 'SRX1', 'IPX6' as substrings of base64). TRUE COUNT OF REAL ACCESSIONS: 0.
_tier_exhaustion_evidence.tier_4_pdf_text_table: The main PDF has no data tables; pages 3-6 and 8 each carry exactly ONE full-page raster image (2051x1840 to 2051x2408 px) plus a caption in the text layer. Figure values are not in the text layer.
_tier_exhaustion_evidence.tier_4b_pdf_vector_geometry: UNAVAILABLE, and this is checkable. page.get_drawings() returns 187 path groups on page 1 (the journal masthead) and only 1-3 on every other page. On the five figure pages (3,4,5,6,8) the counts are 3,2,2,2,2 -- these are the Wiley download watermark and the page rule, not data. There is no vector geometry for any data panel.
_tier_exhaustion_evidence.native_dpi_of_the_figure_rasters: Figure 1 is embedded at 2051 x 2352 px placed on a 492.24 x 564.27 pt rectangle = 299.97 x 300.13 dpi. MEASURED, not assumed; computed as px / rect_pt * 72. All reads below are on the EXTRACTED native image, never on a re-render.

panels.why_tiers_1_to_4_failed: See _tier_exhaustion_evidence. There is no Source Data file, the SI contains zero tables (0 <w:tbl> elements AND 0 occurrences of the string 'Table S' in 959,060 chars), the Data Availability Statement directs readers to the corresponding author, find_repo.py returns zero repositories for both the first author and the PI, a 3,126,538-character accession sweep returns zero real accessions, and page 4 carries 2 vector paths (the Wiley watermark) so there is no vector geometry to read.
panels.verified_against: Three independent checks, all passing: (1) the paper names AT4-13CRA highest and AT4-Bex + AT3-13CRA 'also relatively high' -- our read ranks those exactly 1,2,3 of 41; (2) the paper states the ATX-RA series exceeds the ATX-c-RA series -- our read gives -0.0858 vs -0.4231, Mann-Whitney p=0.0045, 15/20 matched-pair wins; (3) the white point of the diverging colormap lands at value +0.0094, i.e. 0.47% of the half-range from the geometric centre of the bar, which the +-1.0 endpoint labels imply but the figure never prints. Max LUT colour distance over all 123 cells = 3.46 (mean 1.75), below the ~5 threshold that means the geometry is wrong.
